We grew from $1M to $10M ARR in under 12 months and now serve 10,000+ customers.

Fonio is Europe's market leader for AI phone agents for SMBs. Now were expanding globally and into new products.

We move fast, take ownership, give direct feedback, and avoid politics and unnecessary meetings.

Join one of Europe's fastest-growing companies. 1 Ex Commercial Founder (m/f/d) Your Role

As Ex Commercial Founder at fonio, you own one of our products. You're not just shaping the roadmap; you're accountable for the commercial success of the product. Strategy, positioning, go-to-market, and growth all sit with you.

You'll operate like a mini-CEO for your product: making the calls, running the experiments, and carrying the numbers. You won't do it alone: you're paired with a technical counterpart and together you own the product.

What you'll do

 * Own a product - from strategy and roadmap to go-to-market and revenue

 * Define positioning, pricing, and the commercial strategy for your product

 * Work directly with engineering, design, sales, and marketing to ship and grow fast

 * Own the metrics that matter - adoption, retention, and revenue - and be accountable for them

 * Run discovery: talk to customers, validate problems, and decide what gets built

What We Offer

 * Up to €150.000 OTE + equity.

 * On-site in Vienna, Munich, Barcelona or London - relocation package to Vienna if needed.

 * Real ownership of a fonio product: you get to essentially work like an entrepreneur inside of fonio.

 * Maximum autonomy - you run your product like your own company.

 * Everything you need to be successful - if you need it - you?ll get it.

What You Bring

 * Demonstrated track record as a founder or commercial owner - you've built and launched a B2B SaaS product & owned it end to end from the commercial side.

 * Strong commercial instinct: you think in terms of markets, customers, and revenue

 * Comfortable operating with high ambiguity and no predefined structure

 * Sharp analytical thinking paired with a bias for execution

 * Excellent communication in English; German is a strong plus given our DACH focus

 * Bonus: experience with AI products, B2B SaaS, or voice technology

1 Technical GEO Growth Specialist (f/m/d) - full-time Own our GEO strategy

The goal is to make Walls.io the primary source AI engines actually cite for social media feeds, social APIs, UGC, and event marketing. You'll create E-E-A-T-driven content to build our brand presence and topical authority across LLMs and track our brand's share of voice.

Search and AI visibility don't stop at our own site. Where it moves the needle, you can build presence on platforms that shape both organic discovery and how LLMs perceive us: YouTube as a search engine in its own right and Reddit or LinkedIn strategies that feed brand authority and GEO. You decide which channels are worth the effort.

Run GEO growth experiments

Every month, you'll propose, launch, and test a mini project outside your day-to-day: a new channel, content format, tool, or tactic, with success criteria defined upfront and measured throughout.

Manage SEO

Your day-to-day work covers a wide range of SEO topics, from discovering new search terms and building links to updating existing content and conducting regular technical SEO audits.

Automate

You automate before you're asked to. Audits, keyword research, competitor tracking, and reporting run on scripts, AI agents, or workflows you built, not manual pulls from GSC, Ahrefs, or PostHog every week.

What success looks like

In your first 3 months, you've set baselines and launched your first experiments. Over the following quarter, qualified signups and demo requests from organic channels are trending clearly upward, our LLM share of voice is climbing against competitors, and your core reporting and audits run automatically instead of by hand.

Requirements
Who you are

 * Experience: minimum 4 years of experience in SEO, preferably within SaaS. You understand how LLM-generated answers work.

 * Skills: Strong communication skills. Exceptional written and spoken English. Technical background so you can read HTML/CSS/JS, reason about crawlability, publish mini websites independently, and write technical specs for developers when needed.
 * You use AI every day. You've used tools like Claude or ChatGPT way beyond the chatbox. You already automate tasks like reporting, data analysis, audits, and content creation, focusing on outstanding results, no slop.
 * Initiative is at the heart of this role. You must proactively identify opportunities or challenges and take action to address them without waiting for direction. We're looking for a test-and-learn mindset.

You will work in a centrally located office with a lot of natural light and space in a renovated factory building. There's a fully equipped kitchen with big dining tables, sound-proofed phone/video call booths, meeting and focus rooms, and a relaxation area.

 * A collaborative and supportive international team that values open communication and teamwork.

 * Full access to paid AI tooling: Claude, ChatGPT, whatever you need

Additional Information

 * Position: Full-time (38.5 hours/week) based in Vienna.

1 In-House Programmatic Specialist (all genders)
1210 Wien, Job-ID: pze3wyxz 

Your responsibilities

 * End-to-End Campaign Trading & Optimization
You manage the daily setup, pacing, bidding strategies, and optimization of all programmatic display, video, audio, and connected TV (CTV) campaigns. You leverage platform-native bidding algorithms, frequency capping, and custom rules/scripts to consistently hit performance KPIs.
 * Marketplace Management & Publisher Relations
You negotiate directly with supply-side platforms (SSPs) and premium publishers to secure Private Marketplace (PMP) deals and Programmatic Guaranteed (PG) deals that drive efficiency and scale for our campaigns.
 * Creative Management & Ad Operations
You traffic and manage creatives via CM360 (Google stack) or Trade Desk's native creative library, ensuring proper ad serving, rotation, and format compliance across display, video (VAST/VPAID), audio, and CTV formats.
 * Measurement, Attribution & Performance Dashboards
You build transparent, automated performance dashboards to track media costs, tech fees, and platform margins. You implement and maintain conversion measurement using Floodlight activities, CM360 attribution models, and/or Trade Desk Universal Pixel & conversion events.
 * Stakeholder Communication & Community Leadership
You translate complex programmatic data into clear business insights for internal teams (Marketing, Creative, Leadership). You actively contribute to our internal Programmatic Community and share expertise across the organization.

Your qualifications

 * Deep Programmatic Trading Experience
You bring 3+ years of hands-on programmatic trading experience, with at least 2 years of intensive, daily work inside a DSP platform. Proficiency in one platform is required; working knowledge of multiple platforms is a strong advantage. Prior experience at a digital media agency or as a certified Google Marketing Platform (GMP) partner and/or Trade Desk certified partner is highly preferred.
 * Technical Expertise & Platform Mastery
You demonstrate complete fluency in Floodlight tags, CM360 container structures, URL parameters (Google stack) and/or Trade Desk Universal Pixel, conversion event configuration, and tracking parameters. You understand the technical architecture behind modern programmatic advertising.
 * Advanced Analytics & Problem-Solving
You possess advanced skills in data analytics with the ability to interpret complex datasets and translate them into actionable campaign strategies. You troubleshoot creative rejections, pixel drop-offs, and discrepancies across ad servers with ease and precision.
 * Communication & Team Collaboration
You communicate technical concepts clearly and effectively to non-technical stakeholders. You work independently and thrive as part of an English-speaking team, bringing both technical depth and interpersonal excellence. A Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, or a quantitative field is a plus.

Your perspective

Depending on the specific qualifications and professional experience, a gross monthly salary of at least EUR 4.000,- is envisaged (this in any case exceeds the minimum salary under the collective agreement). The final salary agreement will be reached in a personal meeting.

At our client you enjoy and value the freedom of a flexible mix of working from home and in the office. You will also benefit from a flat hierarchy and a transparent company structure. The position is available at the earliest possible entry date. This may best be discussed in a job interview.

How do I apply?

We are looking forward to receiving your online application!

OPTIMUSE is a Vienna-based AI startup revolutionizing the real estate and construction industry. We bring insights to the world's largest asset class that it never had before - both for new developments and existing portfolios. Our AI Hans delivers instant, deep engineering insight into costs, risks and optimization potential, grounded in building physics, simulation and engineering. Backed by international investors and a team of ~25 people from around 10 nations. Become a part of it! 1 Product Manager - Construction & Real Estate (PropTech) (m/f/d) Job description

We're now looking for a Product Manager with experience in the construction industry to take our platform to the next level- owning the roadmap, pricing, and scope along the way. Not managing. Shaping.

Your mission

 * The roadmap across all product areas. You decide what ships next - and you stand behind the why.

 * The path from prototype to platform. You sequence the porting effort in waves, cut scope where it's needed, and keep the codebases together instead of letting them drift apart.

 * Pricing and packaging. You align packaging with sales, keep the unit economics of compute-intensive simulation runs healthy, and own the Stripe catalog end-to-end.

 * Discovery and delivery with customers. You run pilot projects, sit down with asset managers and engineers, translate what you hear into specs, and make sure the platform's reports and studies hold up with customers.

 * Quality standards for simulation results. Engineers have to trust the numbers. You define, per engine, what "good enough to ship" means, and you manage the trade-off between physical accuracy and product speed.

 * The written trail. PRDs, a well-maintained decision log, release notes. Our rule: if it isn't documented, it didn't happen.

Your profile

 * Product management experience in a B2B SaaS environment - with substantial time spent on a technical or data-intensive product.

 * Experience in - or hands-on exposure to - the construction industry.

 * An AI-native way of working: for you, AI is a tool, not a buzzword.

 * Real technical confidence. You question a data model, follow a discussion with engineers, and understand a simulation output well enough to challenge it.

 * A degree that connects building energy systems, simulation, and building operations across engineering disciplines - or equivalent hands-on competence in building analysis and simulation

 * Fluent English; professional German strongly preferred.

Why us?

 * Real impact. Your product decisions feed into real investment decisions and move the platform forward in tangible ways.

 * The full solution chain. From digital twin to performance monitoring - a complete product portfolio rather than isolated one-off projects.

 * Flexible working models. Home-office option & a modern office in the heart of Vienna.

 * And the day-to-day works too. Daily meal allowance (€5/day), regular team events, free snacks.

 * Compensation: €60,000.00 - €80,000.00 gross/year.

jobs.description:
1 Master Thesis "Differentiable Ray Tracing for Radio Propagation Modeling" - JOB ID: 269596  * Differentiable ray-tracing frameworks such as Sionna RT have become powerful tools for wireless channel modeling. This master's thesis advances differentiable ray tracing for realistic large-scale radio propagation, either by integrating atmospheric refraction models or by learning electromagnetic environment properties directly from channel measurements.
 * Under the guidance of our team, you will implement and evaluate atmospheric refraction models in the differentiable ray-tracing framework Sionna RT.
 * You will implement and evaluate differentiable algorithms for estimating electromagnetic material properties from real-world channel measurements.
 * You will learn how to develop and validate simulation workflows for large-scale radio propagation, combining physics-based propagation models with discrete ray tracing, low-complexity ray-shooting, and gradient-based optimisation techniques.

 * You will gain hands-on experience with modern wireless communication simulation frameworks, electromagnetic wave propagation, physics-based and inverse modeling, and AI-enabled optimisation methods.
 * You will work closely with researchers in wireless communications and contribute to the development of next-generation ray-tracing methods for realistic large-scale propagation prediction.

Your qualifications:

 * You are pursuing a master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Telecommunications, Physics, or a related field.
 * First experience in at least one of the following areas: (i) atmospheric refraction modelling for ray tracing or (ii) learning environment properties using differentiable ray tracing. Candidates should explain in their cover letter how their background matches one of these areas and demonstrate relevant expertise.
 * You have solid programming skills in Python; experience with object-oriented software development is an advantage.
 * You have a basic understanding of electromagnetics, wave propagation, wireless communications, or computer graphics.
 * Knowledge of ray tracing, geometric optics, optimisation methods, or machine learning is beneficial but not required.
 * Experience with scientific computing frameworks (e.g., NumPy, TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Sionna) is a plus.
 * You enjoy developing algorithms and solving challenging scientific and engineering problems.
 * You are able to work independently while collaborating effectively in an interdisciplinary research team.
 * English language skills commensurate with the role

What to expect:

 * Duration of the master's thesis project: 6 months
 * Start date: ideally 01.10.2026 - however, there is some flexibility regarding the start date
 * EUR 1.379,60 gross per month for 20 hours/week.
 * Dedicated guidance and supervision from our experienced researchers, who will support you throughout your final thesis - from the initial concept to the final results.
 * Highlights of our employee benefits include a canteen and meal allowance, organic coffee, tea and fruit baskets, preventive healthcare benefits and company doctor, additional days off for various life events, leisure subsidies, voucher programme, sports, cultural and socialising events, as well as flexitime models (incl. home office possibilities).

Among other initiatives, we are committed to increasing the proportion of women in our company and therefore particularly welcome applications from female applicants.
